go.en: I suggest that we go out on Friday.
go.zh: 我建议我们星期五出去玩。

account.en: How do you account for your being late?

get.en: Who are you to tell me to get out?

drop.en: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
drop.zh: 你回家途中順道來看看我吧。

think.en: I must think over the matter before giving my answer.
think.zh: 我在回答之前必须考虑周全。

associate.en: It'd be better if you didn't associate with men like that.
associate.zh: 你最好不要和那样的男人交往。

try.en: I'd like to try out this new model before I buy it.
try.zh: 我想在买之前先试试这个新机型。

regardless.en: He says what he thinks regardless of other people's feelings.
regardless.zh: 他說話從來不理別人的感受。

fault.en: I cannot find fault with him.

after.en: After all she did not come.

call.en: I forgot to call up Mr Ford.
call.zh: 我忘了给福特先生打电话。

serve.en: My uncle made me serve as interpreter.

agreement.en: There is not one person who is in agreement with the plan.
agreement.zh: 贊成計劃的人一個也沒有。

term.en: Tom is on good terms with John.

sit.en: She let me sit by her.

willing.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
willing.zh: 我知道不太可能有人願意幫助我。

end.en: When will the world come to an end?
You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
end.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

wonder.en: You went to bed at 2 o'clock in the morning? No wonder you look sleepy today.
wonder.zh: 你凌晨兩點才去睡覺嗎？難怪你今天看起來這麼沒精神了。

ease.en: She solved the problem with ease.
ease.zh: 她不費吹灰之力就把問題解決了。

time.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
time.zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。

time.en: Take care of yourself, and have a good time!
time.zh: 你自己小心，玩得开心点！

kill.en: I was trying to kill time.

begin.en: To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
begin.zh: 首先我們必須處理這個問題。

past.en: You must live in the present, not in the past.
past.zh: 你一定要活在當下，不能總是留戀過去。

variety.en: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
variety.zh: 下面的解釋是通過比較和對比各種不同的理論。

stand.en: Amy made an effort to stand up.

control.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
control.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

debt.en: He is up to his ears in debt.

refrain.en: Please refrain from smoking in public places.
refrain.zh: 在公共场所请控制自己不要吸烟。

way.en: Some people only buy organic food; they think that in this way their body will not be damaged by pollutants.
way.zh: 一些人只买有机的食物，他们认为这样可以使他们的健康不受污染的损害。

while.en: After a while, the man came into the room.
while.zh: 過了一會，那人就走進了房間。
